title: GenAI Is Not A Defense — Civil And Criminal
content: For a violation of a statute administered and enforced by the Utah Division of Consumer Protection under §13-2-102, §13-77-102 precludes a defense that generative AI made the statement, undertook the act, or furthered the violation. SB 149 first enacted the civil provision at §13-2-12(2), and enrolled SB 226 placed it at §13-75-102. Criminal §76-2-107(2) separately provides that an actor may be found guilty when the actor commits an offense with generative AI’s aid or intentionally prompts or otherwise causes generative AI to commit it.
